title: Startup probe race: two instances, same pool causes startup failure
description: RadosStore::open writes and deletes '_stoa_write_probe'. If two stoa-transit instances start simultaneously against the same pool, both write the probe, then both try to delete it. The second delete gets ENOENT -> error 'RADOS pool X probe cleanup failed' -> startup failure. Fix: ignore ENOENT on probe cleanup (delete succeeding or already gone both mean the pool is writable), or use a randomized probe name.
